title: Three eunuchisms read spiritually, not by the knife
english: On keeping the sequence of the three eunuchisms spiritual. Friends of the bare letter leveled the third with the first two as bodily; we who accept the tropology of the third say the same of the earlier two: tropically, eunuchs are those idle toward lust. The idle differ three ways — by nature ([[born so from the mother’s womb >> Bible:Matthew 19:12]]); by human persuasion; and by God’s Word, cutting desire [[for the kingdom of the heavens >> Bible:Matthew 19:12]]. Do not mutilate the body; [[self-control is a fruit of the Spirit >> Bible:Galatians 5:22-23]].
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 13 Greek Tomus XV rem (tesseract); GCS X–XII not locked.
After tip 515bbfbd; Tomus XV rem CLOSEOUT.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Children offered; rich man; camel; vineyard wage
english: [[Then little children were brought to him >> Bible:Matthew 19:13]] until he laid hands on them. Infants and nurslings in Christ are always offered to Jesus — [[I gave you milk to drink, not solid food >> Bible:1 Corinthians 3:2]]. Then the rich young man asks about eternal life; [[if you want to be perfect, go sell… >> Bible:Matthew 19:21]] — he went away grieving for his goods. [[A rich person will enter the kingdom of the heavens with difficulty >> Bible:Matthew 19:23]] — not impossible, but hard; [[it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye >> Bible:Matthew 19:24]]. [[Many who are first will be last, and the last first >> Bible:Matthew 19:30]]: the vineyard laborers called at different hours receive the same wage. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Condensed Tomus XV rem CLOSEOUT (parvuli through vineyard) from PG 13 OCR.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B; no Heine.
